messages:
claire: Heads-up from today's workshop: the JS + Python sampleapps sometimes render broken JSON if you close the client quickly while a stream is active.
ben: Can you drop minimal repro steps and any logs?
claire: Repro is trivial: start local sampleapp, trigger a long stream, then ctrl+c within ~100-300ms of token emission. Node/browser logs show JSON.parse errors. Snippet: 
```
[info] stream open
[debug] recv: data: {\"msg\":\" He\"
[debug] SIGINT
[debug] flush -> \"llo\"
[error] JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of input
```
claire: Browser shows stack and the UI renders a truncated object; python sample exits non-zero with "truncated token".
oscar: Sounds like the parser.finalize() path emits leftover buffer even when it doesn't end with the SSE delimiter (\n\n). If auth refresh/reconnect kicks in concurrently it can replay fragments and produce duplicates/halves.
ben: Actionable plan: 1) Parser: on finalize only emit if buffer contains a complete SSE event (endsWith('\n\n') or matches full data block). Otherwise drop and debug-log. 2) Sampleapps: add gracefulShutdown() that polls parser.inFlight for up to 150ms before force-closing; fallback env var DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false for instructor demos. 3) UX: catch JSON.parse errors and show "Stream ended early — partial output omitted" instead of crashing. 4) Add tests simulating mid-chunk SIGINT and auth-reconnect interleaving.
oscar: I'll add parser unit tests and a tiny runtime integration that simulates auth refresh + client abort.
claire: I'll open small PRs for JS/Python sampleapps showing the graceful shutdown snippet and the friendly error handling; will tag @ben and @oscar.
ci-bot: issue #5172 created: "streaming: avoid emitting partial SSE events on client shutdown (affects sampleapps & SDK parity)"
ben: Thanks — once PRs land let's add a short devex onboarding note about recommended demo shutdown behavior and include the repro script. :memo:
